title: The upper semi-Fredholm radius, extensions of restrictions, and subprojectivity
summary: For a bounded operator $T$ between Banach spaces, let $d_+(T)$ be its distance to the operators that are not upper semi-Fredholm, and let $\inn(T)$ be Schechter's quantity $\inf\|T|_M\|$ over infinite-dimensional subspaces $M$. One always has $\inn(T)\le d_+(T)$, and González and Martinón showed that the two quantities are not equivalent in general. We prove that $d_+(T)$ is the infimum of the norms of operators on the whole space that extend a restriction of $T$ to some infinite-dimensional subspace. The gap between $\inn$ and $d_+$ thus becomes an extension problem, and projection…
